conditions: This is a fix-version claim: the described @JsonView bypass affects versions >= 2.21.0, < 2.21.4, and is not present starting with this version.
summary: jackson-databind before 2.21.4 (2.21.0-2.21.3) can bypass @JsonView view-based access control for setterless Collection/Map creator properties: BeanDeserializer._deserializeUsingPropertyBased only checked prop.visibleInView(activeView) for creator properties, not the regular property-buffering branch, so a view-restricted setterless collection/map can be populated from untrusted JSON despite the active view excluding it (GHSA-5hh8-q8hv-fr38). Fixed in 2.21.4.
